commit_message:
Add job runner

The SIGTERM handler is installed before fork(): children inherit signal
handlers at fork time, and a child forked first dies on SIGTERM without
flushing its queue.

claim() returns False when another worker already holds the job.

reconnect() waits 50 ms after closing: the broker acks on a 50 ms timer
and a reconnect inside that window gets the old session.
